macroInsight.title: Guideline Ambiguity Detected in Section 2.4
macroInsight.description: Section 2.4 prohibits promotional superlatives but fails to define approved technical positioning frameworks, causing recurring copywriting friction.
macroInsight.originalRuleText: Section 2.4: Marketing drafts must avoid unsubstantiated claims and align with verified product parameters.
macroInsight.proposedAmendment: Proposed Rule Revision v2.4.1: "Marketing drafts must substantiate technical metrics by explicitly citing test parameters (e.g. 'under standard laboratory testing') and use pre-approved value phrases provided in Appendix C."
macroInsight.rationale: Supplies copywriters with unambiguous, pre-approved phrasing templates to eliminate governance roadblocks.
